# Mast sensor

A pole-mounted sensor head that watches the air around a crane for the faint line a fibre-tethered drone trails. The head listens for tiny vibration along the line and compares it with a quiet baseline taken at dawn. The Nimbus Robotics mast is the planned carrier for the head.

Open questions: the range at which the line can be told from wind noise, and whether one head can cover a whole crane row.
